scope: Shared checked CPU int64/uint64 matrix multiplication, exact products/adjacent-pair accumulation, eight-byte allocation bounds and retained structured worker results.

semantics.arithmetic: Check each product before entering the balanced-adjacent sum tree. Check each tree addition before retaining its 64-bit value. Signed64 uses signed i128 intermediates; unsigned64 uses unsigned i128. All possible input products fit those wider representations. No widened-total accumulator, wrapping, saturation or reassociation.
semantics.shape: Rank-two matching element types, checked inner extents and output shapes. Zero inner extent produces typed-zero output cells. Zero output cells skip contraction work and contraction-sized scratch. Input descriptors remain independently validated.
semantics.storage: Existing integer kernel selects MLIR cell/scratch type from its tensor element. Output and scratch limits use eight bytes per cell. Offset/padded/transposed views and aliases remain immutable. Late faults publish no partial tensor; retained output leases survive Invocation::settle.
semantics.tasks: Existing common continuation, tensor retention and scalar reduction machinery. Nested results and cached awaits survive worker/core/destination-invocation destruction. Product, first-pair and later-tree Arithmetic recovery can reuse parent matrices and start a fresh group.
semantics.failure: Dynamic shapes and exact byte limits checked before allocation/read; scratch/output allocation rejection tested. Poll-triggered cancellation uses sender startup handshake. Root cancellation/deadline/admission signals and allocation positions 1..24 settle all scheduler/allocation state.
semantics.remaining: CPU float64 arithmetic/default float, further numeric formats/conversions, Metal integer arithmetic, public foreign-memory/wire ABI and native distributed execution remain separate work.

coverage: Shared 32/64-bit reference harness, checking each product and each adjacent-tree sum independently in wider integer arithmetic
Exact endpoints, above-2^53 cells, UINT64_MAX squared, products around 2^32, INT64_MIN times -1 and product overflow despite mathematical cancellation
1000 deterministic small/full-width random matrix inputs per variant, odd/multilevel trees and late-product/later-cell faults
Noncontiguous padded/offset and transposed inputs, aliases, immutable cells and retained outputs after invocation settlement
Empty contractions and output axes, huge unused contraction extents, negative/mismatched extents, and immediate output/input byte bounds above INT64_MAX/8
Scratch and output allocation rejection, poll-triggered cooperative cancellation with sender-ready handshake
Fixed-shape source, exact CLI full-range endpoints and unsigned near-maximum product, nested/cached worker tensor outputs
Worker/core/destination-invocation destruction before retained result reads; typed layout mismatch rejects observation without publishing data
Product/first-pair/later-tree failures with source 2:3, Arithmetic recovery with original parent data and new parallel group
Root cancellation/deadline/admission and allocation positions 1..24 at 1/2/4 workers; zero retained scheduler/allocation state
Static shape/mixed/rank errors preserve existing executable/LLVM output; Metal integer arithmetic remains rejected
Frontend matrix typing independently sanitized; forged mismatched matmul element types rejected by backend
Existing int32/uint32 matrix suites rerun through the shared harness/driver in all four variants
qualification.gpu_shader_sanitizers: Host ASan/UBSan and TSan do not instrument Metal shaders.

performance: No performance claim or benchmark in this milestone.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design discussion remains a prerequisite.
